title: Build a HarmonyOS NEXT ArkUI (ArkTS) adaptive transit-pass screen across phone and foldable breakpoints

contextSnapshot.surface: HarmonyOS NEXT transit pass and recent-trips screen
states: compact sm vs foldable md/lg breakpoint

prompt: Implement a HarmonyOS NEXT ArkUI screen in ArkTS (.ets) displaying a rider's transit pass and trip history that adapts across phone (sm) and unfolded foldable (md/lg) breakpoints, preserves fp font scaling, and works cleanly offline.
forbiddenBehaviors: translates React/CSS flexbox or Android XML idioms literally instead of idiomatic ArkUI declarative components
uses vp instead of fp for body text sizes or locks text scaling
ignores HarmonyOS foldable breakpoints and safe-area avoid zones
claims DevEco Simulator rendering passed without executing it

rubricDimensions.pass: uses ArkUI @Component/@State, Navigation/GridRow breakpoint adaptation between single-column phone and split foldable view, and vp/fp units accurately
rubricDimensions.fail: stretches a fixed phone layout across a foldable display or invents web/Android APIs

rubricDimensions.pass: uses fp text scaling, accessibilityText/accessibilityGroup semantics, explicit offline cached-pass indicator, and expired-pass recovery flow
rubricDimensions.fail: omits accessibility attributes or blocks transit pass display when offline

rubricDimensions.pass: marks DevEco Previewer/Emulator checks not-checked when unavailable on the host OS
rubricDimensions.fail: claims rendered foldable verification on a host without HarmonyOS tooling

negativeControls.name: unavailable DevEco emulator
negativeControls.input: Linux host has no DevEco Studio or HarmonyOS simulator
negativeControls.mustNot: claim foldable rendering or screen reader behavior is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: hallucinates Android/React-style syntax, uses fixed px/vp fonts, and ignores foldable split layouts and offline pass states
baseline.withSkill: writes idiomatic ArkUI (.ets) with breakpoint adaptation, fp scaling, accessibility semantics, offline state design, and honest not-checked labels
